pglite.label: PGLite
pglite.kind: in-process WASM Postgres with pgvector, on-disk data directory

import.analyze_note: ANALYZE after import, counted in total_seconds, so the planner has statistics as a maintained brain would

quality_control.note: hash embeddings: an engine-to-engine control, not a retrieval-quality claim

memory.method: VmHWM and VmRSS of the benchmark process from /proc/self/status (includes the WASM heap for PGLite and the addon for Rust). Baseline is RSS after the dataset is built and before the engine opens; engine RSS is that value minus baseline. Steady is RSS after 2,000 mixed reads that follow the import.

disk.method: du -sb of the PGLite store after the engine closed

cold_start.method: each rep: a fresh process opens the existing store (connect and initSchema) and answers listPages and one keyword query. For Postgres the server keeps running, so this is a gbrain process start against a warm server. Module load is excluded; the OS file cache is warm.

postgres.label: Postgres + pgvector
postgres.kind: PostgreSQL server with pgvector in a local Docker container, stock configuration, reached over loopback TCP

info.resource_limits: none (the container can use every host CPU and all memory)
info.server_stats: host cgroup v2 files of the container

import.analyze_note: ANALYZE after import, counted in total_seconds, so the planner has statistics as a maintained brain would

quality_control.note: hash embeddings: an engine-to-engine control, not a retrieval-quality claim

memory.method: VmHWM and VmRSS of the benchmark process from /proc/self/status (includes the WASM heap for PGLite and the addon for Rust). Baseline is RSS after the dataset is built and before the engine opens; engine RSS is that value minus baseline. Steady is RSS after 2,000 mixed reads that follow the import.
memory.server_method: container cgroup memory.current minus inactive_file (the docker stats definition), sampled every 100 ms

disk.method: du -sb of PGDATA inside the container after CHECKPOINT

cold_start.method: each rep: a fresh process opens the existing store (connect and initSchema) and answers listPages and one keyword query. For Postgres the server keeps running, so this is a gbrain process start against a warm server. Module load is excluded; the OS file cache is warm.
